properties.scriptContent:
set -e
python3 -c "import urllib.request, os; urllib.request.urlretrieve(os.environ['PACKAGE_URL'], '/tmp/fa.zip')"
# Wait for the role assignment to propagate (RBAC is eventually consistent); the identity may briefly
# see the Function App as 'not found' (masked 403) right after deployment.
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  if az functionapp show -g "$RG" -n "$FUNC_APP" -o none 2>/dev/null; then echo "function app visible after attempt $i"; break; fi
  echo "waiting for RBAC propagation (attempt $i)"; sleep 20
done
az functionapp deployment source config-zip -g "$RG" -n "$FUNC_APP" --src /tmp/fa.zip
